summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 37/37 new iter2 tests + 33/33 iter1 regression tests = 70/70 (100%) passed. All iter1 bugs (POST /api/progres ObjectId, rekap/all-po staffing join) are confirmed fixed. Frontend smoke-tested new features across admin/staff/guest roles - all pass except one MEDIUM issue: /users route is not client-side guarded (staff/guest CAN reach the URL, though API returns 403 and no data leaks).

minor.issue: Returns 404 with empty body if not found (from FastAPI default) - fine, tested.
Does not verify barang existence; silently succeeds on invalid ObjectId matching. Consider checking matched_count.
None of the DELETE endpoints check matched_count/deleted_count; deleting a non-existent id still returns 200 with success message. Consider returning 404 when nothing matched.
Email field is plain str (not EmailStr) - no format validation.
Password stored via hash_password but no min-length validation (accepts single char).

integration_issues.issue: Staff and Guest can navigate to /users via URL bar. Backend correctly returns 403 (no data leak), but the UI still renders the empty UserManagement page. Add role guard in App.js route or in UserManagement component (redirect if user.role !== 'admin').

issues: React accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to each Dialog for a11y.

action_items: Add client-side route guard for /users so non-admins are redirected (e.g., <ProtectedRoute role='admin'> or a Navigate in UserManagement useEffect).
Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to each shadcn Dialog to silence accessibility warnings.
Optional: return 404 in DELETE endpoints when deleted_count == 0 for correctness.
Optional: add EmailStr validation and minimum password length on UserCreate/UserUpdate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1236 lines - strong candidate to split by resource routers (users/, barang/, po/, spk/, rekap/, exports/).
delete_bm and update_bm cast old['po_id'] via ObjectId - if the po_id string is malformed OR the PO was already deleted, this raises 500. Wrap in try/except or use string _id.

get_rekap_progres joins progres by item_id but progres stores 'item_id' as the item's UUID/barang_id string; verify all barang_masuk items have a barang_id populated to avoid keying by None. Currently `f"{bm_id}_None"` groups all items with missing barang_id into the same bucket.
Rekap endpoints do .to_list(1000) without pagination or aggregation pipelines - inefficient at scale; consider Mongo aggregation.
list_users uses find({}, {'password_hash': 0}) which is correct; good. But UserCreate should use EmailStr for validation.
Cannot-delete-self check in delete_user compares user_id (string) to user['_id']; make sure both are stringified consistently (currently OK because get_current_user returns _id as string).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; 1 medium route-guard gap noted

All 70 tests currently green. Frontend: only remaining issue is the missing client-side route guard for /users - staff/guest can hit the URL directly (backend correctly 403s, but UI shell renders). Guest Per Pengrajin tab appears visually disabled in shadcn Tabs (correct behaviour).
rca_of_the_issue: Route guard gap RCA: App.js routes /users to <UserManagement /> without checking user.role. AuthContext exposes role but the route is defined only inside <DashboardLayout>, which does not verify permission for a specific path. Fix: wrap the /users route with a role-check component, or add `if (currentUser.role !== 'admin') navigate('/')` in UserManagement's useEffect.
